newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Four killed in clash over petrol tanker in Somalia.
newsitem.headline: Four killed in clash over petrol tanker in Somalia.

text.p: Four people were killed and six wounded when an argument between Somali militiamen at a checkpoint in southern Mogadishu on Friday turned into a firefight, setting a petrol tanker and a nearby fuel depot ablaze, witnesses said.
They said two militiamen loyal to faction leader Hussein Aideed argued over how much they should levy in "taxes" on the tanker, which had crossed into south Mogadishu from the north.
In the clash, an anti-tank rocket hit the tanker, setting it ablaze and killing its driver. The explosion reached a nearby fuel depot and destroyed 150 barrels of diesel, oil and petrol.
The tanker was one of three that crossed the Green Line battle zone dividing Mogadishu. The other two were undamaged.

Somalia has had no central government since the fall of late dictator Mohamed Siad Barre in 1991. Foreign aid agencies say its rival faction leaders must improve security before they can increase aid to drought-hit areas of the Horn of Africa country.
